claim_scope: Source-level candidate multiset for the proposed 88-file JavaScript UCI reference inventory; not a CodeQL oracle.

parser_provenance.tuple_multiset_comparison: 576 Acorn tuples vs 576 Babel tuples; no differing keys or multiplicities

interpretation.optional_handling: The corrected Acorn pass excludes only the optional MemberExpression node and does not suppress nonoptional descendant member accesses inside a ChainExpression.
interpretation.computed_name_handling: Parentheses are stripped for supported static literals; arbitrary constant folding is not attempted and unresolved names are <unknown>.
interpretation.position_basis: Acorn parser locations; spans are converted to one-based inclusive columns. Source expression slices were checked against each pinned source using parser offsets.

limits: This is a parser-derived planning inventory, not a complete CodeQL source oracle.
No CodeQL run, AST mapping, extractor-routing assertion, or query-output inspection is represented.
Optional-chain inclusion remains subject to the proposal contract; this artifact records the per-member interpretation exercised by corrected Acorn and synthetic controls.
No inference about identifier binding, invocation, runtime behavior, configuration effects, authorization, security, reachability, or completeness.
The earlier Acorn script/output remain preserved; its 573 rows used recursive optional-chain suppression and are superseded for this corrected comparison.
